candidate_workaround: Capture Git add diagnostics and exit code before projecting only warning count, then read staged-review receipt fields rather than streaming every advisory.
failure_signature: Git add emitted many line-ending advisories and the compound stage-and-review command exceeded the bounded output display despite completing successfully.
recurrence_guard: For large Windows staging sets, capture Git diagnostics and exit status before displaying only counts; never infer staged-review success from truncated console presentation.
rollback: Hold the commit, retain the truncated presentation, inspect the exact review receipts read-only, and restage only after bounded diagnostic capture.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local staging recovery only; exact Git index blobs remain authoritative and no independent-reproduction or broader assurance credit is earned.
title: Capture Git staging diagnostics before compact projection
trigger_preconditions: line-ending advisories may exceed display limits
